title: Circular Forearm Rubbing
summary: Small circles are applied over the muscular forearm.
goal: Warm the soft tissues before kneading.
instructions: Place the finger pads on muscle.
Make small circles that move with the tissue.
tips: Move tissue rather than rubbing skin.
warning: Do not massage with acute pain, recent injury, marked swelling, inflammation, or impaired sensation.
